config.title: Active Users
config.description: Users active in the 28 days, 7 days and on the day of the latest usage report

config.title: Acceptance Rate
config.description: Share of generated code accepted over the latest 28-day usage report

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CAST("codeAcceptances" AS DOUBLE)) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CAST("codeGenerations" AS DOUBLE)), 0), 1), CAST(0 AS DOUBLE)) AS "rate" FROM "metrics"

config.title: Copilot Pull Requests
config.description: Pull requests created and reviewed by Copilot over the latest 28-day usage report

config.title: Active Users Trend
config.description: Daily, weekly and monthly active users over the latest 28-day usage report

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'Daily' AS "measure", CAST("dailyActiveUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "dailyActiveUsers" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'Weekly' AS "measure", CAST("weeklyActiveUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "weeklyActiveUsers" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'Monthly' AS "measure", CAST("monthlyActiveUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "monthlyActiveUsers" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

config.title: Monthly Chat and Agent Users
config.description: Users active in the 28 days to each day: all of Copilot, Copilot Chat, and agent mode

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'All Copilot' AS "measure", CAST("monthlyActiveUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "monthlyActiveUsers" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'Chat' AS "measure", CAST("monthlyActiveChatUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "monthlyActiveChatUsers" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'Agent' AS "measure", CAST("monthlyActiveAgentUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "monthlyActiveAgentUsers" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

config.title: Daily CLI, Cloud Agent and Code Review Users
config.description: Users of Copilot CLI, the cloud agent and Copilot code review each day

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'CLI' AS "measure", CAST("dailyActiveCliUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "dailyActiveCliUsers" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'Cloud agent' AS "measure", CAST("dailyActiveCloudAgentUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "dailyActiveCloudAgentUsers" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", 'Code review' AS "measure", CAST("dailyActiveCodeReviewUsers" AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "metrics" WHERE "dailyActiveCodeReviewUsers" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

config.title: Interactions and Acceptances
config.description: Prompts sent, code generated and code accepted each day

config.title: Acceptance Rate Trend
config.description: Share of generated code accepted each day, with the report average

config.title: Activity by Feature
config.description: Interactions each day, by Copilot feature

config.title: Activity by IDE
config.description: Interactions per IDE over the latest 28-day usage report

config.title: Users by Adoption Phase
config.description: People in each AI adoption phase on their latest report day

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "login", arg_max("adoptionPhase", "day") FILTER (WHERE "adoptionPhase" IS NOT NULL) AS "phase", arg_max("adoptionPhaseNumber", "day") FILTER (WHERE "adoptionPhase" IS NOT NULL) AS "phaseNumber" FROM "users" GROUP BY "login") SELECT "phase", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "users" FROM "latest" WHERE "phase" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "phase" ORDER BY MIN("phaseNumber"), "phase"

config.title: Top 10 Languages
config.description: Code accepted per language over the latest 28-day usage report

config.title: Copilot Policies
config.description: Plan, seat assignment and feature policies for the organization (organizations only)

config.title: Inactive and Unused Seats
config.description: Seats with no Copilot activity in the last 30 days, or no recorded activity. Click a row to open the profile on GitHub

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "assignee.login" AS "login", "assignee.name" AS "name", "activity[Expanded].rawState" AS "activity", CAST("daysSinceActivity" AS DOUBLE) AS "idleDays", "last_activity_at" AS "lastActivity", "last_activity_editor" AS "editor", CASE "plan_type" WHEN 'business' THEN 'Business' WHEN 'enterprise' THEN 'Enterprise' WHEN 'access' THEN 'Copilot access' ELSE "plan_type" END AS "plan", "assigning_team.name" AS "team", "created_at" AS "assigned" FROM "seats" WHERE "activity" <> 'success' ORDER BY "idleDays" DESC NULLS FIRST, "login"

config.title: Usage by User
config.description: Each person's activity and AI credits over the latest 28-day usage report, with their latest adoption phase and IDE. Click a row to open the profile on GitHub

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "login", arg_max("adoptionPhase", "day") FILTER (WHERE "adoptionPhase" IS NOT NULL) AS "phase", arg_max("primaryIde", "day") FILTER (WHERE "primaryIde" IS NOT NULL) AS "ide", CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "day") AS DOUBLE) AS "activeDays", ROUND(SUM(CAST("aiCreditsUsed" AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS "credits", SUM(CAST("interactions" AS DOUBLE)) AS "interactions", SUM(CAST("codeAcceptances" AS DOUBLE)) AS "acceptances", ROUND(SUM(CAST("codeAcceptances" AS DOUBLE)) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CAST("codeGenerations" AS DOUBLE)), 0), 1) AS "acceptanceRate", SUM(CAST("modelRequests" AS DOUBLE)) AS "requests", MAX("day") AS "lastDay" FROM "users" GROUP BY "login" ORDER BY "credits" DESC NULLS LAST, "interactions" DESC NULLS LAST
